verdict.rationale: React's docs show it can be embedded into existing DOM nodes (createRoot, hydrateRoot, 'add React to an existing project') which implies some level of native DOM interoperability, but the evidence pack never mentions React's actual escape-hatch mechanism (useRef/refs) that developers use to directly manipulate DOM nodes for integrating third-party libraries like charting tools. missing for 10: explicit docs on useRef/refs for direct DOM access, real-world examples of integrating charting/visualization libraries (e.g., D3, Chart.js) via refs, community corroboration of this specific pattern.
